definitionZh: 色彩 CSS 属性设置元素文本和文本装饰的前景色值,并设置当前颜色值. 当前Color可能被用作其他属性的间接值,是其他色彩属性的默认值,例如边框-颜色.
sourceDefinition: The color CSS property sets the foreground color value of an element's text and text decorations, and sets the currentColor value. currentColor may be used as an indirect value on other properties and is the default for other color properties, such as border-color.
